title: When the Escarpment Burns
author: Sable Reyes
blurb: Silas Voss, a riverboat captain who knows every sandbar's mood, keeps moving because stopping costs more. Then the river gives up a chest stamped with a dead nation's seal — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, they must cross the range ahead of the snows before the dry season ends.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
